users.name: Leila Haddad

users.name: Ivan Petrov

Find a community educator to co-design a beginner session on reading energy charts, combining my data skills with their experience helping people learn together.

users.name: Hana Sato

users.name: Musa Diallo
users.instructions: I am a bicycle mechanic in Leeds and want to help neighbors learn to fix punctures and adjust basic fittings. I can volunteer one Sunday afternoon a month and bring hand tools. Ask me before committing to an event, lending tools, or agreeing to repairs beyond my stated scope.

users.name: Elena Kovacs

I want a useful community learning project, and can help people describe observations and read simple charts without assuming technical knowledge. Ask me before leading a workshop, publishing observations, or committing to regular information updates.

users.name: Tariq Khan

I can explain local priorities and meet online on Thursday evenings, but I cannot authorize spending or release household records. intents.intent: Find an analyst who can help our community group turn area-level energy figures into questions residents can discuss before choosing a local efficiency project.

users.name: Petra Lind

I can discuss a potential project's fit remotely but cannot promise certification, revenue, or funding. Ask me before requesting project records, proposing commercial terms, or committing to an assessment.

intents.intent: Find community climate project organizers interested in exploring a commercial carbon-credit program with formal emissions measurement and a multi-year commitment.

users.name: Soren Hansen
users.instructions: I am a Leeds allotment gardener hoping to start a small neighborhood growing and compost group. I can teach seed propagation and spend Saturday afternoons with a regular team. Ask me before agreeing to a site, recurring duties, buying materials, or bringing additional volunteers.

intents.intent: Find neighbors interested in practical climate resilience through a shared growing and compost project, starting by finding a site and a team willing to look after it over time.

users.name: Dev Shah
